reason: E1 and E3 show KKR-CPA accurately computes structural properties and that ANN can predict formation energies/lattice parameters from KKR-CPA data, but no cited evidence supports the leap to predicting free energies or phase transition temperatures, nor the claimed cost reduction relative to MD.

ANN can learn from KKR-CPA data to predict formation energies and lattice parameters
